title: IleZa.pl Model Context Protocol (MCP) Tools Specification
description: Formal contract definition for Polish Market & Tax MCP tools exposed to AI agents.

tools.name: list_polish_used_price_products
tools.description: List product configurations (smartphones, laptops, RAM, cars) tracked for Polish marketplace fair price history.

tools.name: get_polish_used_price_history
tools.description: Get dated, manually reviewed Polish marketplace asking-price observations for one exact product slug.

tools.name: calculate_polish_income_comparison
tools.description: Calculate Polish contract and tax net income comparison for a company budget.

tools.name: update_polish_used_price_observation
tools.description: Admin tool: Add or update a verified Polish used price observation for a product slug. Authorization is handled via the Authorization header.
